# solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref-low

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

`solo` (one agent implements both features) with the frozen reference settings (`gemini-3.8-flash` on Vertex AI, 500 steps, compaction at 128K tokens, step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap) at `low` thinking instead of the default `medium`, on the 50-pair `flash` subset. It is the `low` row of the thinking sweep the team agreed to report alongside the `medium` reference runs.

## Observations

- 30/50 (60%) at `low` vs. 37/50 at `medium` with the same settings. Pair by pair, 7 pairs passed only at `medium` and none only at `low` (exact two-sided test, p = 0.016), so `medium` is the better default for `solo` at 128K.
- Earlier `solo` `low` runs at 64K scored 36/50 and 32/50. The 30/50 here is within that spread, so the larger window does not help `solo` at `low`: with short `low` conversations, only 5 of 50 agents compacted at all.
- Median 83.5 steps per agent; one agent reached the 500-step limit. Cost `$36.81` (`$0.74` per pair), about half of `medium` (`$65.46`).
- At 8 pairs at a time overnight, the run finished in 84 minutes with 1 retry, peaking near 6M input tokens per minute on one project.
